entities.name: Chu Shong Tin
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Chu Shong-tin was grand master of Wing Chun kung fu who had lived in Hong Kong. He was the third student of the famous teacher Yip Man, and remained at Yip Man's school to become his senior instructor.
